['Airbus Operations GmbH '].company_description: Airbus Operations GmbH, a subsidiary of Airbus, operates in the aircraft manufacturing industry. It is known for its production of the Airbus A320 family of narrow-body airliners, which includes the A318, A319, A320, and A321. The company is also involved in the development and production of the A320neo (new engine option), which offers improved fuel economy. Additionally, Airbus Operations GmbH is associated with the Airbus-owned plant in Hamburg-Finkenwerder, Germany, where corporate, freight, test, and delivery flights, including those of the former Airbus A380, take place.

['EWE AG '].company_description: EWE AG is an electric utility company based in Germany, and it is the main sponsor of the professional basketball club Baskets Oldenburg. The company is also associated with the Kleine EWE Arena, a dual indoor sporting arena complex located in Oldenburg. Additionally, EWE AG is involved in high-tech start-up investments through its participation in the High-Tech Gründerfonds.
